title: Interaction to Next Paint percentiles
sqlTemplate: select approx_percentile_cont(view_interaction_to_next_paint, 0.5) as p50, approx_percentile_cont(view_interaction_to_next_paint, 0.75) as p75, approx_percentile_cont(view_interaction_to_next_paint, 0.95) as p95, count(*) filter (where view_interaction_to_next_paint is not null) as sample_count from _rumdata where service = {{service}} and env = {{environment}}{{version_clause}} and type = 'view'
emptyDataSemantics: sample_count = 0 -> p50/p75/p95 are SQL NULL -> NO_DATA, never rendered as 0ns.
